{{Conjecture|legends}}
A '''planet''', which was liberated by [[Empire of the Hand]] [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]], was the origin point of the [[A-rack]] rolling vehicles the Grand Admiral used during a [[Attack on the Red City|battle]] against [[Storm-hair|alien]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]] on the<ref name="Crisis of Faith">{{StoryCite|story=Crisis of Faith|book=Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition}}</ref> [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} — Based on corresponding data for [[Quethold system/Legends|Quethold system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quethold]]<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]].<ref name="TERC">The events of ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'' take place in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''.</ref> Imperial [[Stromma contingent]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Lhagva]] remembered where the A-racks originated during the conflict.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

==Behind the scenes==
The planet was mentioned in the [[2011]] novella ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'', written by [[Timothy Zahn]] and published within the [[Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition|20th Anniversary Edition]] of Zahn's [[1991]] novel ''[[Heir to the Empire]]''.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />
